primary_paper.title: An innovative approach for FMCW radar vital sign monitoring with removal of respiratory harmonics

parameter_supporting_paper.title: SSA-VMD for UWB Radar Sensor Vital Sign Extraction

parameters.ssa_reconstruction_rule: paper singular-value rule; threshold described as 0.1*L position

compatibility_audit.paper_input: UWB echo-derived one-dimensional signal; approximately 50 s resting recording
compatibility_audit.project_input: 10 Hz decoded range-FFT tensor; 30 s window gives approximately 300 slow-time samples
compatibility_audit.blocking_fact: published L=400 exceeds the project 30 s sample count; changing L, padding, or reconstruction rank would be a new unverified method rule

recommendation_boundary: The recommendation is based on the project baseline failing the frozen HR gate and the only time-bounded external route being non-adaptable without invented parameters; it is not an external-method performance claim.
